title: Pig holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'>
  <!-- Pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#FF9EB5'/>
  <!-- Pig body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#FFB8C9'/>
  
  <!-- Pig head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#FF9EB5'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='14' fill='#FFB8C9'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='22' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#FF9EB5' transform='rotate(-25 34 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='22' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FF7096' transform='rotate(-25 34 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='22' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#FF9EB5' transform='rotate(25 66 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='22' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#FF7096' transform='rotate(25 66 22)'/>
  
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FF7096'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#FF85A8'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#E05070'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#E05070'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#3A2040'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#3A2040'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFD0E0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFD0E0'/>
  
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF6B8A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='42' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF6B8A' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 49 Q50 53 56 49' stroke='#E05070' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <!-- Left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='55' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF9EB5' transform='rotate(-30 30 55)'/>
  <!-- Right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='55' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF9EB5' transform='rotate(30 70 55)'/>
  
  <!-- Heart held in front -->
  <g transform='translate(50 58)'>
    <path d='M0 8 C-2 4 -10 -2 -8 -8 C-6 -14 0 -12 0 -8 C0 -12 6 -14 8 -8 C10 -2 2 4 0 8Z' fill='#FF3355'/>
    <path d='M0 6 C-1 3 -7 -1 -6 -6 C-5 -10 0 -9 0 -6 C0 -9 5 -10 6 -6 C7 -1 1 3 0 6Z' fill='#FF6B80'/>
    <ellipse cx='-3' cy='-5' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#FFB0C0' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='4' fill='#FF9EB5'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='4' fill='#FF9EB5'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#E07090'/>
  <rect x='58' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#E07090'/>
  
  <!-- Curly tail -->
  <path d='M78 62 Q84 58 82 64 Q80 70 76 66' stroke='#FF7096' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
